# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within this repository or the live site, please report it responsibly:

1. **Do not create a public issue.**
2. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature via the [Security tab](https://github.com/EoinTraynor/eointraynor.github.io/security/advisories/new).
3. Alternatively, contact Eoin Traynor directly via the contact links listed on [eointraynor.github.io](https://eointraynor.github.io).

Please provide details regarding the potential vulnerability, including steps to reproduce, impact assessment, and any proposed remediations.
